title: soulboundsmp
description: A unique Minecraft survival plugin where players lose Soul on death, become ghosts at 0 Soul, complete quests to recover, and fight to stay alive.
body:
# 👻 SoulboundSMP

SoulboundSMP is a unique survival plugin that introduces a Soul system to Minecraft.

Every player starts with 100 Soul.

## 💀 Death Has Consequences

Each time you die, you lose Soul.

If your Soul reaches 0, you become a Ghost and must earn your way back to life.

## 👻 Ghost Gameplay

Ghost players gain unique abilities:

- Limited flight
- Invisibility
- Monster immunity
- Special Ghost Quests
- Soul recovery progression

However, ghosts cannot interact with the world like normal players.

## 🎯 Quest System

Players can complete difficult quests to recover Soul.

Examples include:

- Mining thousands of blocks
- Killing large numbers of mobs
- Defeating Wardens
- Completing Ghost challenges

Each quest can only be completed once unless reset by staff.

## ✨ Soul Fragments

When a player dies, a Soul Fragment is dropped.

Recovering your own fragment rewards additional Soul and helps you return to life faster.

## 📦 Spectral Death Chests

Upon death, items are stored in a protected Spectral Chest.

- Owner-only access for a limited time
- Automatically becomes public later
- Removed when empty

## 🧠 Broken Soul Effects

Players with low Soul begin experiencing supernatural effects:

- Darkness
- Strange sounds
- Ghostly apparitions
- Visual disturbances

## 🌍 Official BelgiumSMP Plugin

SoulboundSMP was created for BelgiumSMP Season 6 and provides a completely different survival experience where every death matters.

Live. Die. Earn your Soul back.
